page.layout: Running head at top, centred across the page: "Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 31 at right. Below it one main text column on the left, with a narrow margin column to its right holding two marginal notes ("De Laicis 3.19. sect.4." and "In praefatione ad Imp. & Principes."). Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the right margin and is not transcribed. The bottom catchword "mo," sits at the foot of the column.

main_text.p: tamen (Bellarminus inquit) De Laicis 3.19. sect.4. pax Lutheranis. Intelligat hoc nunc orbis vniuersus, & obstu- pescat; Rex noster (vt æmulari quibus non licet, inuideant; Deus bone, quantus & inter Principes Theologus, & Princeps Theologorum, Rex hominum, Regum stupor; quàm & sceptro potens & calamo!) hæreseos sibi maculam (vah quam spurcâ manu adspersam) deterfurus; profitetur serio, sanctéque, quicquid vel pagina sacra, vel Symbola tria, vel Concilia quatuor in se complexa fuerint, illud se totum vlnis ambabus amplexari illud profiteri, illud ore, cala-In praefatione ad Imp. & Principes.

page.notes: Right margin carries faint show-through from the reverse page, not transcribed. Catchword "mo," is printed at the foot. Marginal note text in the right column is small and partly obscured; readings follow the scan as closely as possible.
